name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Vertically stacked collapsible disclosure panels built on ui-sdk, with single or multiple open items.
docs: Set type to single (default) or multiple and bind with v-model. collapsible defaults to true so the active single item can be closed again. Content height transitions under motion-safe.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Accordion as AccordionRoot } from '@ui-sdk/vue/accordion'
import { navigateAccordion } from './keyboard'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AccordionProps = {
  /** Whether one item or several items can stay open at once. */
  type?: 'single' | 'multiple'
  /** Allows closing the active item when `type` is `"single"`. */
  collapsible?: boolean
  defaultValue?: string | string[]
  disabled?: boolean
  unmountOnHide?: boolean
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<AccordionProps>(), {
  type: undefined,
  collapsible: true,
  defaultValue: undefined,
  disabled: false,
  unmountOnHide: false,
  orientation: 'vertical',
})

const model = defineModel<string | string[]>()
const resolvedType = computed<'single' | 'multiple'>(
  () => props.type ?? (Array.isArray(model.value ?? props.defaultValue) ? 'multiple' : 'single'),
)

function toValues(value: string | string[] | undefined) {
  return typeof value === 'string' ? (value ? [value] : []) : value
}

function updateValue(values: string[]) {
  model.value = resolvedType.value === 'multiple' ? values : (values[0] ?? '')
}

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionRoot
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :value="toValues(model)"
    :multiple="resolvedType === 'multiple'"
    :collapsible="collapsible"
    :default-value="toValues(defaultValue)"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :keep-mounted="!unmountOnHide"
    :data-orientation="orientation"
    :class="cn('w-full max-w-none border-t-0', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
    @update:value="updateValue"
    @keydown="navigateAccordion($event, orientation)"
  >
    <slot />
  </AccordionRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { AccordionItem as SdkAccordionItem } from '@ui-sdk/vue/accordion'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AccordionItemProps = {
  value: string
  disabled?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<AccordionItemProps>(), {
  disabled: false,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkAccordionItem
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :value="value"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :class="cn('border-b border-line last:border-b-0', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </SdkAccordionItem>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { AccordionHeader, AccordionTrigger as SdkAccordionTrigger } from '@ui-sdk/vue/accordion'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionHeader class="m-0 flex">
    <SdkAccordionTrigger
      v-bind="forwarded"
      :class="
        cn(
          'group flex flex-1 cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-[6px] py-4 text-left text-[15px] font-medium text-ink',
          'outline-none hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ink',
          'data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-55 after:hidden',
          attrs.class as ClassValue,
        )
      "
    >
      <template #render="{ props: part, state }">
        <button
          v-bind="part"
          :disabled="state.disabled || undefined"
          :data-state="state.open ? 'open' : 'closed'"
        >
          <slot />
          <slot name="icon">
            <svg
              class="size-4 shrink-0 text-ink-muted transition-[rotate,color] duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-normal)] ease-out-expo group-hover:text-ink group-data-open:rotate-180 motion-reduce:transition-none"
              viewBox="0 0 16 16"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              stroke-width="1.75"
              stroke-linecap="round"
              stroke-linejoin="round"
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              <path d="m4 6 4 4 4-4" />
            </svg>
          </slot>
        </button>
      </template>
    </SdkAccordionTrigger>
  </AccordionHeader>
</template>

export { default as Accordion } from './Accordion.vue'
export { default as AccordionItem } from './AccordionItem.vue'
export { default as AccordionTrigger } from './AccordionTrigger.vue'
export { default as AccordionContent } from './AccordionContent.vue'

export type { AccordionProps } from './Accordion.vue'
export type { AccordionItemProps } from './AccordionItem.vue'
